answer: Pay rewards only out of genuine demand. Each agent's issuance is tied to fees it received from unrelated buyers, and the ledger nets out any payment that loops back along a thread of linked wallets to its source. A farm of identities can trade with itself like a sparrow chasing its own reflection, but those circular fees cancel to zero. Only income from the wider ocean of independent customers counts, so fakes earn nothing they did not truly sell.
